paragraphs: R' Nehemiah, a man of Beqa'at Hortan. See the entry R' Hunya.[^1]

notes.text: ערך introduces the connected pointer to Hunya on the next line; earlier machine OCR had עיך. Beqa’at Hortan is retained without a geographical identification. Hunya’s vowels are conventional, and both abbreviated titles remain R'.
